create_normalized_vit_model: create a normalized ViT model with image size 256, patch size 16, 1024 dim, 6 depth, 8 heads, and 1000 classes
run_normalized_vit_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the normalized ViT model with a batch of 4 RGB images of size 256x256
build_attention_with_l2norm: build a multi-head attention module with L2-normalized query and key projections and learnable scaling parameters
build_feedforward_with_gelu: build a feedforward module with NormLinear layers, SiLU gating, and learnable hidden and gate scaling parameters
test_norm_weights_convergence: test the norm_weights_ method to copy normalized weights back to original parameters for weight convergence
